bibl.title: Draft of Late Coptic Letter.
bibl.seg: 141.13 P. Cair. Bibl. Nat. Inv. 3241-3242 = P. Christ. Musl. 25
Anne Boud'hors & Maher A. Eissa, Draft of Late Coptic Letter.
Lajos Berkes (ed.), Christians and Muslims in Early Islamic Egypt = American Studies in Papyrology. 56 (Durham, NC, 2022) pp. 161-167, figg.
bibl.note: Middle Egypt (?), 9th-10th century. The letter is of particular interest, as its study contributes our knowledge of language use and the transition from Coptic into Arabic in medieval Egypt.
